text: Take a few akshintalu in your hand and, remembering Shiva and Keshava in your mind, say this sankalpam.
“In this holy Karthika masam, for the grace of Shiva and Keshava, I perform this daily puja with devotion and faith.

I pray that everyone in our family is blessed with long life and good health, happiness and peace, and prosperity; that the troubles and obstacles in our lives are removed; and that, with good thoughts, we are given the strength to walk the right path.
For the pleasure of Sri Shiva and Keshava, I begin this Karthika masa daily puja.”
Offer the akshintalu at the feet of Shiva and Keshava.
